verses.1: A prayer for deliverance from David’s troubles.
verses.2: In You, LORD, I take refuge forever, in Your righteousness. Save me from all evil.
verses.3: Please listen to me quickly! Save me! Be my refuge, and help me out of this difficult situation.
verses.4: For you are my rock and my refuge. May your name be blessed upon me, and may it guide me.
verses.5: Help me get out of this situation. You’ve trapped me here, because you’re the one who has done this to me.
verses.6: In your hands I entrust my soul. May Jehovah be my true refuge.
verses.7: I love those who are faithful and steadfast. I trust in Jehovah completely.
verses.8: I am glad and rejoice in your kindness, for you have seen my suffering and understood the distress of my soul.
verses.9: And you did not hold me in your grasp, when you stood in the space between my legs.
verses.10: May the LORD have mercy on me, for my heart is troubled by anger. My eyes and my soul are also in turmoil.
verses.11: For all my days and years have been spent in sorrow. My strength has been drained away, and my body has become weak.
verses.12: Among all my troubles, I was filled with shame and fear for my servants. They were terrified, and they fled from me.
verses.13: I have forgotten completely. I was like a dead person in my heart; I was completely destroyed.
verses.14: For I have heard the words of many people from all around, who together ask me to take my life.
verses.15: And I have placed my trust in you, LORD. I said, “You are my God.”
verses.16: In your hands I entrust my safety, from the hands of my enemies and those who persecute me.
verses.17: May your light shine upon your servant, and may you save me by your grace.
verses.18: YHWH, do not be merciful to them, for they have called out to you. The wicked will be punished, just as the sheep are driven away from the shepherd’s fold.
verses.19: They spoke lies with false lips about the righteous man, in anger and hatred.
verses.20: What great good it is that you have sought to fear your Lord! You have done what was right in your own eyes, and you have protected yourself from the children of men.
verses.21: Hide them in your secret places; let no one see them. Let those who envy them be ashamed of their actions.
verses.22: Blessed is Jehovah, for He has shown His kindness to me in the city of Mitzor.
verses.23: And I said in haste, “I’m being attacked from your side.” Now, you have heard the sound of my cries to you.
verses.24: Love the LORD, as all His servants truly do. They are true followers of the LORD, and they deserve to be rewarded for their efforts.
verses.25: Strengthen and renew your hearts for Jehovah.
